# PR body — P26.16 (GL-GATE-07 camera-registry rights batch)

> Stacked on `devin/p26-15-eu-tenders` (PR #107). Ticket:
> `docs/tickets/P26.16__rights-batch-execution.md` (SOURCES.15).
> Run ledger: `docs/build/runs/P26.16.md`.

## What this lands

**Executes the recorded GL-GATE-07 blanket rights disposition** over the
P26.13 catalog-sweep remainder: the 257 gated camera-registry-shaped rows
+ the individually-named `camreg_stalbert_ab` — the largest single
expansion lever in the backlog. US rows flip under
`LicenseRef-PublicRecord-FactualCompilation` (facts are not
copyrightable; municipal portals publish as public records), non-US /
unresolved-jurisdiction rows under `LicenseRef-OperatorAccepted-DBRight`
(the operator's explicit risk acceptance), OSM-derived mirrors under
`ODbL-1.0` — each in its own export compartment.

**The whole 257-row worklist is classified, not just flipped**
(`docs/build/tools/p2616_batch.py` — deterministic reviewed constants,
idempotent `--plan`/`--plan-json`/`--apply`): **181 wired** into
`camera_registry_targets.toml` with state + jurisdiction_scheme on every
row; **34 covered** by already-registered endpoints (recorded
`covered_by_registered`, no duplicate wiring); **42 explicit
non-targets** preserved as `[[enumerated]]` negative outcomes —
person-level ALPR reads, camera registration forms, citizen-submission
directories, ecological/pipe-inspection CCTV, and the other
camera-registry-shaped-by-title datasets are never flipped, never wired,
never force-fit into the camera schema.

**151 flipped sources** (136 new + 15 existing flips incl. St. Albert)
through the existing `dot_511` connector — `runner.py` maps,
`live_targets.toml` `dot_511_targets` rows, kind-correct `api_allowlist`
prefixes (`/arcgis/rest/`, `/server/rest/`, `/resource/`),
`licenses.toml` + two new compartments (`public_record` 57 /
`operator_accepted` 93 — `export-check` green), vocab `2026.09.18.3`
with the batch layers' observed id aliases + media-blocklist names for
device IPs/MACs/serials, stream URIs, and officer/editor name fields
(recorded excluded, never emitted). Rights evidence: batch packet +
per-row dispositions JSON + **153 annexes**.

**Manageable batches.** `ops/cadence.toml` gains `camreg-batch-01..08`
monthly `[[batches]]` (11–26 targets each); `sig-ops scheduled-ingest
--batch` iterates members through the same gated `run_source` with one
run row per member; `scheduled-ops.sh` upserts the 8 jobs + schedulers.

## Live

Local live sweep (`--sink memory`, `SIG_RUN_LOG=live_runs/p2616`):

0 rate-limits / 0 disappearances.** First pass recorded 7 honest
`content_drift` outcomes; root-caused to real schema quirks (DMS-text
coordinates, projected `x`/`y`, a publisher-swapped Lat/Lon, a

  vocab `2026.09.19.1` (+`ObjectID`, `object_id`, `location_1`);
  ebrgis `object_id_field="ID"`, portland `page_size=200`.

output (claims carry no volatile field → content-keyed dedupe).
